candidateIntervals.priority: strong secondary example for a selected axis and facing direction
candidateIntervals.before: A separate metal hook lies beside a wooden board.
candidateIntervals.action: The hook is grabbed and raised; at239.5–243.5 the native game UI shows a vertical red arrow and a horizontal purple-blue rotation ring as the hook opening changes its facing direction.
candidateIntervals.result: By244.5–245 the upright hook is attached to the board with the green binding effect.
candidateIntervals.narratedClaim: 옮기는 조작과 돌리는 조작은 구분된다. 축을 정하면 그 둘레로 물체의 방향이 바뀐다.
candidateIntervals.beginnerSetup: 울트라 핸드로 물체를 집고 R을 누른 채 방향버튼으로 수직/수평 회전한 다음 A로 붙인다.
candidateIntervals.nativeGuide: The red axis and purple-blue ring are already present in the actual gameplay; do not overpaint them or relabel them as verified X/Y/Z axes.
limits: Initial grab changes pose rapidly; do not infer that every part of the ground-to-upright change was an explicit rotation-button input.
Do not call the purple-blue ring a full measured3D gizmo or claim an exact90degree input.
The finite interval is a complete action, not the full puzzle solution.
candidateIntervals.safeNext: Match-cut the hook or shaft into the existing authored model, where our axis and signed numeric angle are controlled.

candidateIntervals.priority: optional short prerequisite before sail rotation
candidateIntervals.before: A loose horizontal log rests beside another log.
candidateIntervals.action: The loose log is grabbed and moved alongside the other.
candidateIntervals.result: The two parallel logs are attached around994.75–995.
candidateIntervals.narratedClaim: 어디에 놓을지 정하는 위치 조작과 길쭉한 물체가 향하는 방향은 구별해서 살펴볼 수 있다.
candidateIntervals.beginnerSetup: Green highlighting marks the grabbed object; the attachment prompt and green binding effect identify the join.
limits: This interval primarily demonstrates translation and joining, not a clean large angular change.
Camera motion prevents a claim that world-space orientation is numerically constant.
candidateIntervals.safeNext: Continue to the neighboring sail operation; the same raft establishes a concrete object rather than resetting the lesson.

candidateIntervals.priority: main story opening and later confirmation
candidateIntervals.before: A sail assembly with its mast lies flat on the ground beside the newly joined logs.
candidateIntervals.action: The sail is grabbed around999.5, lifted while still broadly horizontal1000–1002.75, then turned upright around1003.25–1003.5. The shaft is moved toward the raft.
candidateIntervals.result: The upright sail is attached to the two-log raft around1007.25–1007.75.
candidateIntervals.narratedClaim: 위치를 옮기는 것만으로는 원하는 자세가 되지 않는다. 돛을 세우려면 방향도 바꿔야 한다. 위치와 자세는 별도의 정보다.
candidateIntervals.beginnerSetup: Show the raft goal, name the entire sail assembly, and distinguish its mast from the two horizontal float logs. R+direction buttons enters rotation.
limits: The object is a sail assembly. A horizontal log does not transform into a mast.
The projected center and camera both move. Do not say the game keeps the exact same3D center during this action.
The final state is visibly upright, but the UI shows no exact numeric angle, Euler convention, intrinsic order or internal representation.
Use our controlled model to establish an exact quarter-turn or90degree numeric example.
candidateIntervals.safeNext: Carry the visible upright mast into our world/local-axis model while narration continues. Return to this real outcome after the concept is explained.

candidateIntervals.priority: short payoff following the sail operation
candidateIntervals.before: The sail and logs are now one joined structure on land.
candidateIntervals.action: The complete raft is picked up and carried to the water, then released around1019.75. Link swims and boards it1020.5–1022.
candidateIntervals.result: By1024 the raft carries Link on the lake, with the sail still standing on the float logs.
candidateIntervals.narratedClaim: 방향을 맞춰 조립한 부품이 하나의 물체가 되었고, 이제 그 전체의 위치를 옮겨 사용할 수 있다.
candidateIntervals.beginnerSetup: Explain that joined pieces move together; this is visible behavior, not a statement about the internal scene hierarchy.
limits: Avoid the mostly waiting/static1027–1039 stretch; it adds no new rotation evidence.
Do not claim measured wind, angular velocity, transform matrices or parent-child engine implementation.
Source original camera changes framing; use purposeful contours and clear marks at cuts.
candidateIntervals.safeNext: Use as a brief real-game confirmation, not a standalone long sailing chapter.
